options.name: init_config
options.description: All options defined here are available to all instances.

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Additionally, this sets the default `service` for every log source.

options.name: instances
options.description: Every instance is scheduled independently of the others.

options.name: db_identifier
options.description: Identifies the target database for this query configuration.

options.name: username
options.description: The database username for authentication.

options.name: password
options.description: The database password for authentication.

options.name: port
options.description:
The database port to connect to.
If not specified, defaults to 5432.

options.name: ssl
options.description:
SSL mode for PostgreSQL connections.
Valid values: disable, allow, prefer, require, verify-ca, verify-full.

options.name: ssl_cert
options.description: Path to the client SSL certificate.

options.name: ssl_root_cert
options.description: Path to the SSL root certificate authority.

options.name: ssl_key
options.description: Path to the client SSL private key.

options.name: ssl_password
options.description: Password for the client SSL private key.

options.name: aws
options.description: AWS configuration for RDS IAM authentication.

options.name: managed_authentication
options.description: Azure Managed Identity configuration.

options.name: config_id
options.description: An identifier for tracking this query configuration via Remote Config.

options.name: db_type
options.description: The database engine to connect to. Currently only 'postgres' is supported.

options.name: queries
options.description:
List of SQL queries to execute with per-query scheduling.
Each query has its own interval and timeout settings.

options.name: tags
options.description:
A list of tags to attach to every metric and service check emitted by this instance.

Learn more about tagging at https://docs.datadoghq.com/tagging

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Overrides any `service` defined in the `init_config` section.

options.name: min_collection_interval
options.description:
This changes the collection interval of the check. For more information, see:
https://docs.datadoghq.com/developers/write_agent_check/#collection-interval

options.name: empty_default_hostname
options.description:
This forces the check to send metrics with no hostname.

This is useful for cluster-level checks.

options.name: metric_patterns
options.description:
A mapping of metrics to include or exclude, with each entry being a regular expression.

Metrics defined in `exclude` will take precedence in case of overlap.
